connection_gate.forbidden_body: This server only admits devices on its tailnet. Connect from a device on the server's tailnet, then try again.
connection_gate.not_admin_title: This device can't open taproot yet
connection_gate.no_access_body: {{node}} has no access to taproot yet. On a device that is already an admin, open Access and turn on Admin or Proxy for it. New devices show up there marked New.
connection_gate.not_admin_body: {{node}} can send model requests but can't open the dashboard. On a device that is already an admin, open Access and turn on Admin for it.
connection_gate.not_admin_body_unnamed: This device has no access to the dashboard. On a device that is already an admin, open Access and turn on Admin for it.
connection_gate.unreachable_body: The management API did not answer. Check that the server is running.
